Package io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.transport

Class PemLoader

java.lang.Object
io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.transport.PemLoader
public final class PemLoader extends Object
PEM parser for X.509 certificates and PKCS#8 private keys.

Deliberately narrow: this class handles the PEM formats that openssl req + openssl pkcs8 + Zenoh's PEM samples emit, and rejects everything else with a helpful error message. It does not pull in Bouncy Castle or sun.security.*; everything is JDK stdlib.

Supported certificate PEM

  • -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- / -----END CERTIFICATE----- blocks. Multiple concatenated blocks in one file are supported; useful for leaf + intermediate chains.

Supported private-key PEM

  • -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- — PKCS#8 unencrypted. The modern format, what openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt produces. Native handling via PKCS8EncodedKeySpec.
  • -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- — PKCS#1 traditional RSA. What older openssl req still emits by default. This loader wraps it in a minimal PKCS#8 envelope in memory before decoding, so users don't need to run openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt first.
  • -----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY----- — PKCS#1-style EC. Same wrap-in-PKCS#8 treatment.

Not supported (documented, will throw)

  • -----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY----- — encrypted PKCS#8 keys. Users should convert with openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt first, or use PKCS12 keystores which handle passwords natively.
